title: TE Connectivity’s Record Orders Say the AI Trend Is Real — Its Stock Reaction Says Guidance Still Rules
excerpt: The physical infrastructure enabling artificial intelligence requires considerably more than just high-performance accelerators and primary grid connections....
content_html:
Sheryar Siddiq

Tue, July 28, 2026 at 1:19 PM EDT 4 min read

The physical infrastructure enabling artificial intelligence requires considerably more than just high-performance accelerators and primary grid connections. It also relies on millions of high-density connectors, backplane interconnects, and power-filtering devices to connect rack-level structures, areas where TE Connectivity plc (NYSE:TEL) holds a significant bottleneck position. As hyperscalers and enterprise data center operators ramp up capital expenditure deployment around the world, demand for critical electrical connector systems has transformed from a passive secondary tailwind to a direct beneficiary of the AI growth cycle.

The company's fiscal third-quarter 2026 report showed this demand in real time, with record top-line performance, order velocity, and profitability. Despite exceeding Wall Street expectations in every fundamental indicator, shares fell roughly 7% following the release, indicating the market's focus on sequential forecast trends over historical trailing figures.

Record Q3 Operations and Astrodyne M&A

Operational execution in the third quarter set new highs across numerous business areas. Net revenue increased 14% year-over-year to $5.16 billion, above Wall Street expectations by more than 3%. Adjusted earnings per share rose 22% year-over-year to $2.94, exceeding the average estimate of $2.85. The report's defining metric was order flow, which increased 27% year-over-year to a record $5.7 billion, reflecting over $1 billion in incremental booking expansion vs. the prior year period. Meanwhile, profitability increased significantly, with adjusted operating margins improving 90 basis points to 22% and quarterly free cash flow totaling $883 million.

The underlying sector distribution highlights where AI momentum is growing the fastest. Industrial Solutions revenue increased 22% year-over-year to $2.58 billion, driven mainly by data center rack deployments and energy infrastructure growth. Chief Executive Officer Terrence Curtin stated that AI cloud momentum is far above initial multi-year predictions, with data center connection and power distribution orders rising more than 70% year-to-date.

Moreover, to back up its power-handling portfolio, TE Connectivity plc (NYSE:TEL) signed a $1.4 billion formal agreement to acquire Astrodyne TDI. The acquisition includes specialized power management and electromagnetic filtering solutions for critical industrial, semiconductor, and defense applications, providing approximately $250 million in annual revenue to the Industrial Solutions segment once completed.

content_html_zh:
谢里亚尔·西迪克

2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二下午 1:19（美国东部时间） 阅读时间 4 分钟

支持人工智能的物理基础设施需要的不仅仅是高性能加速器和主要电网连接。 它还依赖数百万个高密度连接器、背板互连和电源滤波设备来连接机架级结构，而 TE Con​​nectivity plc（纽约证券交易所股票代码：TEL）在这些领域占据着重要的瓶颈位置。 随着超大规模企业和企业数据中心运营商加大全球资本支出部署，对关键电气连接器系统的需求已从被动的次要推动力转变为人工智能增长周期的直接受益者。

该公司 2026 年第三季度财报实时显示了这一需求，并创下了创纪录的营收业绩、订单速度和盈利能力。 尽管各项基本指标都超出了华尔街的预期，但该股在发布后仍下跌了约 7%，这表明市场关注的是连续预测趋势而不是历史跟踪数据。

第三季度运营和 Astrodyne 并购创纪录

第三季度的运营执行力在多个业务领域创下新高。 净收入同比增长 14%，达到 51.6 亿美元，比华尔街预期高出 3% 以上。 调整后每股收益同比增长 22% 至 2.94 美元，超过平均预期 2.85 美元。 该报告的定义指标是订单流量，订单流量同比增长 27%，达到创纪录的 57 亿美元，反映出与去年同期相比增量预订扩张超过 10 亿美元。 与此同时，盈利能力显着提高，调整后的营业利润率提高了 90 个基点，达到 22%，季度自由现金流总计 8.83 亿美元。

基本行业分布凸显了人工智能势头增长最快的领域。 工业解决方案收入同比增长 22% 至 25.8 亿美元，主要受到数据中心机架部署和能源基础设施增长的推动。 首席执行官Terrence Curtin表示，AI云的发展势头远高于最初的多年预测，数据中心连接和配电订单今年迄今增长了70%以上。

此外，为了支持其电力处理产品组合，TE Con​​nectivity plc（纽约证券交易所代码：TEL）签署了价值 14 亿美元的正式协议，收购 Astrodyne TDI。 此次收购包括针对关键工业、半导体和国防应用的专业电源管理和电磁滤波解决方案，一旦完成，将为工业解决方案部门带来约 2.5 亿美元的年收入。
